key_concepts: Clouds form when water vapor condenses in the atmosphere.
Clouds form at different heights depending on atmospheric conditions.
Warm water in the jar models warm moist air near Earth's surface.
Ice on the jar cover models cooler conditions in the upper atmosphere.
Hairspray particles act as condensation nuclei for cloud formation.
Swirling cloud movement is caused by convection currents.
Habagat is a southwest monsoon bringing warm, humid air and heavy rains.
Amihan is a northeast monsoon bringing cold, dry air and light rains.
Monsoons affect different parts of the Philippines.
Different monsoon conditions are associated with different cloud types.
